ul.li: The die hot spot in the Figure 4 approximately corresponds to the Base Power workload as described in Section 3.11.1. Under the Base Power workload and at a room ambient temperature of 35°C, Intel estimates that a thermal solution for the PCH could be required to keep the PCH sensor temperature at 113°C or below.

The need for a thermal solution for the PCH will be determined by the usage condition targeted for the system design, the local ambient temperature around the PCH, and the room ambient temperature specifications.
